candidates.change_summary: Change comparison in first if from '<' to '<=' so _BASE_TARGET_ updates when _BASE_RESERVE_ equals _BASE_TARGET_ as well.
Change comparison in second if from '<' to '<=' so _BASE_TARGET_ updates when _QUOTE_RESERVE_ equals _QUOTE_TARGET_.
Swap assignments in first branch so _QUOTE_TARGET_ is set before _BASE_TARGET_, changing final stored _BASE_TARGET_ ordering semantics.
Remove the line that sets _BASE_TARGET_ in the first branch so it no longer updates _BASE_TARGET_.
Change first branch to set _BASE_TARGET_ to (_BASE_RESERVE_ + 1) to intentionally differ final _BASE_TARGET_.
